decision: Supersede TQP-D041's exact release pins and Gate F evidentiary basis with a committed-tree assembled large-terrain acceptance proof. Preserve TQP-D041 as history, keep the TQP order unchanged, and allow TQP-58 only after the corrected TQP-57 evidence passes fail closed.
finding: The first TQP-D041 release bundle proved isolated and bounded CPU terrain behavior but did not directly prove the assembled 2048x256x2048 production terrain and its live mixed-LOD seams. The new acceptance run also exposed a cached-transition constraint splitter cycle in world-transvoxel before promotion. Therefore TQP-D041 was under-proven for the assembled large-terrain claim and its exact pins are historical, not current release authority.
evidence: world-transvoxel commit 4f1fdb59e3c6200c8f823b99027b2d3f15563858 replaces recursive transition-face constraint splitting with bounded triangulation; the exhaustive terrain/water mask corpus passes 1458 meshes with at most 153 transition indices

review: Gate F is current only for the corrected pinned matrix and assembled acceptance profile. The report's base revision must equal the production commit, all three LODs must be live, every scenario and capture must pass, and mixed-LOD topology, collision, and persistence must pass. Any stale or missing field fails qualification.
downstream_impact: TQP-58 may now evaluate GPU architecture against a directly qualified assembled CPU terrain baseline. GPU work cannot replace or weaken this baseline by assumption.
